newsitem.title: ISRAEL: King Hussein carrying new proposal to Netanyahu.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein carrying new proposal to Netanyahu.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein will present Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu with a compromise proposal on Sunday setting a new timeframe for further Israeli troop withdrawals from the West Bank, a PLO official said.

"The king is carrying with him a compromise that has been discussed with the Americans, Egyptians and Arafat," the official, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters after the monarch met Palestinian President Yasser Arafat. "It will be submitted to Netanyahu tonight."

U.S.-brokered talks between Israel and the PLO over self-rule for the town of Hebron have reached an impasse over the timing of three further Israeli redeployments from mainly rural areas of the West Bank.
"The first phase of the redeployment has been agreed with the Israelis to start on February 28," the official said, disclosing the starting date for the first time.
"The three phases...will be completed within 12 months of the implementaton of the first phase, but not later than mid-1998," he said.

Israel has proposed to complete the West Bank pullbacks by May 1999 and the United States has suggested mid-1998. The PLO had demanded Israel stick to a peace deal under which the withdrawals were to have been completed by September this year.
